purpose: Codex follow-up review 29.09 (J1-J3), state v5: one reading of each person's municipality for both search lanes and the saved state. A negated place stays negated even when a search query names it, a clause of the person decides and not another sentence with the same place, two places of one person stay ambiguous, a move replaces the old place, and a place in another script is linked to the user's own word. Written before any run; run on the code before (v4) and after (v5) the change.

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn (the catalogue and the knowledge lane's municipal texts); null when the person the request is about has no one known municipality
expectation_help.state_region / person_regions: the saved dialogue state: the focus person's region and the user's own region ("user")

scenarios.title: Kasutaja ei ela Koses, ema elab

turns.text: Mina ei ela Kose vallas. Minu ema elab Kose vallas ja vajab koduteenust.
Aga mina ise? Kust mina oma elukohas abi saan, kui mul on võlad?

scenarios.title: Kolis Kosest ära, uus koht teadmata

turns.text: Elasin Kose vallas, aga enam ma seal ei ela. Kust ma saan abi, kui mul pole raha üüri maksta?
Kas Kose vallas on mingi toetus, mida ma veel saaksin?
Elan nii Harku vallas kui ka Kose vallas, mul on kaks kodu. Millist abi ma saan koduseks hoolduseks?
Elan Kose vallas ja mul on raske toime tulla.
Ma ei ela enam Kose vallas, elan nüüd Harku vallas.

scenarios.title: Venekeelne: ema Kose vallas, kasutaja Tallinnas

turns.text: Моя мама живёт в Козе, ей нужна помощь по дому.
А я сама живу в Таллинне. Куда мне обратиться за помощью для себя?
